# Tommy Jackett

> Tommy Jackett is a Melbourne filmmaker and storyteller. He co-hosts and co-wrote the documentary In Guns We Trust (2026), and runs VIDPOD, a video production company.

Facts that stay the same: In Guns We Trust is a 76 minute documentary, free on YouTube worldwide from Thursday 22 October 2026 at 8pm US Eastern (Friday 23 October 2026 at 11am Melbourne time, AEDT). It is directed by Josh Janssen and made by 2A Film, Full Stack Films and Rethink Films. Tommy Jackett co-hosts and co-wrote it. The film takes no side on guns.

## Stories
- [The Jackett Ranch](https://tommyjackett.com/stories/jackett-ranch/): In the '70s my family bought 8.5 acres in America for $5,000. Nobody had been to see it. So I went to have a look.
- [Making In Guns We Trust](https://tommyjackett.com/stories/making-in-guns-we-trust/): Josh and I took a crew across America to make In Guns We Trust. These are my own photos from the road.
- [DJ Bodhi](https://tommyjackett.com/stories/dj-bodhi/): His creativity is electric. I just put a magnifying glass on it.
- [oBike](https://tommyjackett.com/stories/obike/): In September 2017 oBikes were everywhere in Melbourne, including the bottom of the Yarra. So I grabbed a hook.
- [The 7-Eleven cup](https://tommyjackett.com/stories/7-eleven-cup/): A bloke named Josh showed in 2016 that a $3 coffee fits in a $2 cup. My mate and I checked if it still did in 2018. It's old footage, so they may have fixed it.
- [Domino's pepperoni](https://tommyjackett.com/stories/dominos-pepperoni/): Domino's promised 100 pieces of pepperoni. I ordered one and counted every piece.
- [Have A Crack](https://tommyjackett.com/stories/have-a-crack/): I've been having a crack at all sorts of things for years, from a personal training business to radio to TV presenting.
- [The Daily Talk Show](https://www.thedailytalkshow.com): More than 1,000 episodes with Josh.
